cohort: The study included data from 10,458 deliveries with fetuses weighing 500g or more at Hacettepe University Hospital across the years 1976, 1986, 1996, 2006, and 2016.
finding: Cesarean section rates dramatically increased from 11.4% in 1976 to 77.9% in 2016, becoming the preferred method for multiple pregnancies and breech presentations, with Robson-10 Group 5 being the greatest contributor to this increase.
mod_finding: The study observed a substantial increase in cesarean section rates over the decades, alongside a decrease in operative vaginal deliveries.
